sections.Profile:
The Vampire pinball machine, produced by Bally in 1971, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Ted Zale with artwork by Dick White. With a theme centered around horror and myth, it features two flippers, three pop bumpers, six standup targets, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Myth and Legend, Original Theme, Vampires, 1970s, Horror
